Added here as a standalone, honestly-tagged gap-fill (group.secondary: ["nearby-bright-star-gap-fill"]) via the same SimbadResolver/acquire mechanism, not as a claimed member of the original RECONS-nearest-100 candidate batch - see data/raw/gap_fills/README.md.
